page_title: BOL 1-3 GEN | Bologna v Genoa 24/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dan Ndoye (Bologna) heads on.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.

90+1' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Benjamin Siegrist anticipates the shot and makes a decent save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bologna.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna). Marco Monaldi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' Davide Calabria (Bologna) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Marco Monaldi's book.
87' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.

86' Benjamin Siegrist was forced into action to thwart Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot towards the roof of the net but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.

86' Koni De Winter (Genoa) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just wide of the left post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.

84' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
84' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
83' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
83' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Bologna get a corner.
82' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
82' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) replacing Brooke Norton-Cuffy.
81' The substitution is prepared. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Remo Freuler.
80' Jean Onana (Genoa) is booked.
79' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
77' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) swings in a cross from the corner, but Benjamin Siegrist reads it well and gathers the ball.
76' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bologna win a corner.
76' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Monaldi interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Bologna.
75' Substitution. Charalampos Lykogiannis walks off the pitch and Davide Calabria (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
75' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
75' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

74' Bologna fail to score from a corner as Benjamin Siegrist (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
74' Handball! A player from Genoa handled the ball. A free kick to Bologna.
71' Remo Freuler (Bologna) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
71' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
69' Marco Monaldi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tommaso Pobega (Bologna). A free kick has been awarded to Genoa.
68' Junior Messias (Genoa) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
67' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Monaldi saw the whole situation. Genoa have a free kick.
66' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.

64' 1 - 3 Nicolo Casale sends an inch-perfect lofted cross into the box. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot which hits the underside of the bar and bounces in off it. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:3.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes onto the pitch so that Vitinha can be given a rest.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) replaces Mattia Bani.
63' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Benjamin Siegrist and he is replaced by Daniele Sommariva (Genoa).
63' Substitution. Lorenzo Venturino leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
60' Referee Marco Monaldi sees the trip by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Genoa earn a free kick.
60' Half-chance! Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) plays a pass into the box, but Benjamin Siegrist reacts well to snuff out the attack.
58' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
57' Remo Freuler (Bologna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) takes a short corner kick.
56' Santiago Castro goes off the pitch and Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) comes on.
56' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
56' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) is about to take a corner kick.
55' Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bologna will take a free kick.

54' Santiago Castro (Bologna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
53' Remo Freuler (Bologna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Monaldi no option but to blow his whistle. Genoa have a free kick.
52' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) gets booked for the first time in this match.
51' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
49' Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marco Monaldi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
46' Half-time substitution. Michel Aebischer will not participate anymore and Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Emil Holm is replaced by Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna).
46' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Marco Monaldi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Bologna! Play can continue.

45+2' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Bologna.
45+1' PENALTY APPEAL by Bologna, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
45+1' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Genoa is cautioned for aggressive play. Bologna are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' 0 - 3 Fantastic team goal! Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) was set free in the area by Vitinha and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
41' A lofted cross from Emil Holm (Bologna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

39' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
38' Marco Monaldi shows a yellow card to Michel Aebischer (Bologna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
38' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Marco Monaldi blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Genoa will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
37' Marco Monaldi interrupts the game. One of the players from Bologna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Genoa are awarded the free kick.
37' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
36' A clumsy foul by Emil Holm (Bologna) and Marco Monaldi blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Genoa.
34' Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
33' Emil Holm (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
32' The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Jean Onana (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and Marco Monaldi blows his whistle for a foul. Bologna get a free kick.

26' 0 - 2 Goal! Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Federico Ravaglia had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:2.
26' The referee blows his whistle as Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Genoa in a dangerous position.
26' Bologna restart play with a quick free kick.
25' Marco Monaldi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Aaron Martin (Genoa) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Bologna.
23' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Siegrist is equal to it and makes an easy save.
23' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Bologna win a free kick.
19' Santiago Castro (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Monaldi blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Genoa, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

17' 0 - 1 Aaron Martin produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Vitinha (Genoa) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the bottom left corner. What a brilliant finish. 0:1.
17' Aaron Martin (Genoa) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
17' A pass from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is intercepted by Benjamin Siegrist and the move breaks down.
16' Jean Onana (Genoa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Monaldi signals.
14' Rough tackle by Jean Onana (Genoa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Marco Monaldi blows for a foul after Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
11' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
9' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Michel Aebischer (Bologna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Now Bologna have a corner.
6' Jean Onana (Genoa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Monaldi blows for a foul.
4' An accurate cross picks out Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
3' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
3' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) makes a strong challenge and Marco Monaldi blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Marco Monaldi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
